newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Arabian Airlines to fly in 312,300 pilgrims for the annual pilgrimage at Islam's holiest shrines.
- U.S.-GCC economic talks open in Riyadh.
- Belgium launches a major export promotion drive in Saudi.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan begins an official visit to Britain on Wednesday.
- Saudi's Taiba Real Estate Investment and Development Co posts 36 million riyal net profit in 1996, down from 50 million riyals in 1995.
